mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), reduced manufacturing output lowers corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of HOUST rising periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL > 4.0% (y/y) periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion with slowing industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and decelerating GDP growth (GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized), S&P 500 underperforms due to earnings pressure over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with slowing industrial production
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized, or joint condition Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
